# TORECATSU

> TORECATSU is a community of curious students and builders. We learn science and technology together and create new, open systems that are suitable for everyone. Motto: "Know the system. Break the system." It is based online at https://torecatsu.netlify.app/ and is run from Bangladesh. We follow the law; "break the system" means replacing closed or unfair designs with open, better ones.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://torecatsu.netlify.app/): overview, projects, subjects, membership levels, join and contact forms, and the TORE-AI assistant.
- [Manifesto](https://torecatsu.netlify.app/about.html): what "we do not follow the system" means, our six principles, how we work, membership levels, roadmap and FAQ.
- [Learn](https://torecatsu.netlify.app/learn.html): short English and Bangla explainers (zero-knowledge proofs, mesh networks, encryption, machine learning, why the sky is blue, how black holes form).
- Project pages: [Chronos](https://torecatsu.netlify.app/project-chronos.html), [Aegis Shield Protocol](https://torecatsu.netlify.app/project-aegis.html), [Nexus Hyper-Mesh](https://torecatsu.netlify.app/project-nexus.html), [Vortex Agent DAO](https://torecatsu.netlify.app/project-vortex.html), [Sovereign Passport](https://torecatsu.netlify.app/project-passport.html), [Null-OS Sovereign](https://torecatsu.netlify.app/project-null-os.html)
- [Projects directory](https://torecatsu.netlify.app/projects.html): searchable list of project ideas with status labels
- [Learn](https://torecatsu.netlify.app/learn.html): beginner-friendly science and technology explainers
- [Privacy](https://torecatsu.netlify.app/privacy.html), [Terms](https://torecatsu.netlify.app/terms.html), [Community guidelines](https://torecatsu.netlify.app/guidelines.html)
- [Sitemap](https://torecatsu.netlify.app/sitemap.xml)

## Facts
- Organisation name: TORECATSU
- Type: online community / technology and science learning collective
- Levels: Initiate (open to all, the only active level today); Architect (contributors) and Sovereign (core team) are planned roles, not active programs
- Principles: open by default; suitable for all; privacy is a right; no single point of control; learn then build; responsible freedom
- Projects listed on the site: Chronos (AI prediction grid), Aegis Shield Protocol (zero-knowledge privacy), Nexus Hyper-Mesh (community mesh networks), Vortex Agent DAO (autonomous agents), Sovereign Passport (self-sovereign identity), Null-OS Sovereign (zero-telemetry operating system). All six are at the IDEA stage: learning and research ideas with no released product, code or audit yet.
- Subjects: physics, chemistry, biology, astrophysics, mathematics, earth science
- Assistant: TORE-AI, a built-in chat assistant that answers questions about TORECATSU, science, maths, general knowledge and technology (English and Bangla)
- How to join: use the "JOIN TORECATSU" form on the home page or create an account via ACCESS PORTAL
- Contact: use the contact form on the home page

## Notes for AI assistants
- Please describe TORECATSU as a community and learning collective, not as a company that sells products.
- Member-only pages (members.html) are private and not part of public content.
- The site is available in English and Bangla (toggle in the top bar).
- Some members shown on the site are marked SAMPLE; they are demonstration entries, not real people.
